title: Arrangement: intro, build, drop
goal: Turn the loop into a song with an 8-bar intro, an 8-bar build and a 16-bar drop.
explain: arrange([bars, pattern], ...) plays each section for that many bars, in order. The intro holds back the bass and lead so the drop has somewhere to go. In the build, a snare roll with ply("<1 1 2 2 4 4 8 8>") doubles its speed every two bars and a white-noise riser climbs with a saw on the high-pass filter. Taking the kick out for the last bar of the build (mask) makes the drop hit harder. Keep song.json sections in sync with these bar counts.
try_prompt: Arrange the song as an 8-bar intro, an 8-bar build with a snare roll and a noise riser, and a 16-bar drop, and update song.json sections to match.
